Are you an independent mechanic who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join an environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialised in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a MARINE MECHANIC.

As a SHIP MECHANIC, your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing mechanical maintenance and repairs on ships;
  • Working on different vessels, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on-site and working independently on the scheduled tasks;
  • Being responsible for the maintenance, dismantling and assembly of mechanical components;
  • Working on engines, drive systems, pumps and other mechanical installations;
  • Detecting mechanical faults and defects and providing suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out mechanical interventions and repairs;
  • Checking and testing installations after completing the work;
  • Actively thinking along with technical issues and independently looking for solutions.
As a MARINE MECHANIC in OSTEND, you recognise yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial mechanics;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a valid driving licence B;
  • Previous experience in an industrial environment is preferred;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You can work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are proactive and resourceful and know how to find solutions yourself;
  • You are willing to take responsibility.

For our client, we are looking for a PLASTERER.

As an all-round plasterer, you will be responsible for various plastering and finishing works. You will work on both interior and exterior projects and ensure a neat and high-quality finish every time.

Your responsibilities as a PLASTERER:

  • Carrying out plastering works;
  • Preparing surfaces;
  • Applying and finishing interior and exterior plaster;
  • Repairing and touching up existing plasterwork;
  • Finishing corners, edges and connections;
  • Working with spray cork;
  • Working with different materials and techniques;
  • Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish;
  • Working on different construction sites and projects.
This is you as a PLASTERER:

  • You have experience as a plasterer or renovation worker;
  • You can work independently, but also work well as part of a team;
  • You have an eye for detail and deliver a neat finish;
  • You are physically fit;
  • You speak Dutch or fluent Englisch;
  • You have a valid category B driving licence.

As an ELECTROMECHANIC – DAY SHIFT in WEST FLANDERS, you will work closely with our clients to ensure the optimal performance and efficiency of their machinery and contribute to their operational success.

Your responsibilities as an ELECTROMECHANIC in WEST FLANDERS:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical and electrical faults, including under time pressure;
  • Carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule;
  • Actively contribute ideas for improvements related to machinery, safety, quality and efficiency;
  • Participate in optimization and continuous improvement projects;
  • Contribute to a smooth and efficient production environment;
  • Work in a refrigerated production environment (4–6°C) that is cleaned industrially on a daily basis. Safety, cleanliness and quality are key priorities.
AS AN ELECTROMECHANIC IN WEST FLANDERS, YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF IN THE FOLLOWING:
  • You have a degree in electromechanics or relevant experience as a maintenance or breakdown technician, with a strong focus on electrical systems;
  • You have an analytical mindset and can quickly identify and resolve technical faults efficiently;
  • You can work independently and take responsibility in a mature and professional manner;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English;
  • You are motivated to grow and develop within a company that is continuously expanding.

Apply now for this vacancy or send your CV to westkust@absolutejobs.be.

For our client located in BRUGES, we are looking for a ROOFER.

Do you enjoy working at heights and do you have experience as a roofer, mainly working on pitched roofs? Then we are looking for you!

As a ROOFER in the Bruges region, your day will look like this:

  • Mainly covering pitched roofs, but occasionally also flat roofs;
  • Renovating existing roofs (no new-build projects);
  • Installing roofing materials;
  • Assessing the structural characteristics of existing roofs;
  • Installing and sealing carpentry elements in the roof;
  • Bonding and installing EPDM.
As a ROOFER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a roofer, with experience working on pitched roofs;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges, Blauwe-Toren area;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the VEURNE region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client in MIDDELKERKE, we are looking for a CHEF – THAI CUISINE.

This is a family-run business where, in time, you will have the opportunity to run the entire kitchen independently and take on responsibility within the business.

Do you have extensive knowledge of Asian cuisine, or do you have solid experience as a chef and are you eager to learn Thai cuisine? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Your responsibilities as CHEF – THAI CUISINE in MIDDELKERKE:

  • You are responsible for preparing dishes from the Thai cuisine;
  • You take care of the mise-en-place;
  • You cut vegetables and prepare meat and vegetable ingredients;
  • You ensure a professional presentation and finishing of the dishes;
  • You check deliveries and ensure that products are stored correctly;
  • You correctly store all products in the cold room; this is physically demanding work;
  • In time, you will take full responsibility for the kitchen and the entire menu independently;
  • You actively contribute to the daily operation and take responsibility within the kitchen.
This is you as CHEF – THAI CUISINE in MIDDELKERKE:

  • You have experience as a chef, preferably within Thai or Asian cuisine;
  • You can work independently and are comfortable taking responsibility;
  • A good command of English is important to learn and follow the recipes correctly;
  • You are reliable and take ownership of your kitchen;
  • You work accurately and maintain high standards of hygiene;
  • You are flexible and stress-resistant during busy services;
  • You are motivated to take on full responsibility for the kitchen in the long term.

For our client located in Bredene, we are looking for a CNC TURNER.

As a CNC TURNER in the Bredene region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • You will sometimes produce small series of parts, while other times you will make unique, customer-specific pieces;
  • You will work on a wide range of components, from large rollers and large-diameter parts to wear sleeves for pumps and parts for combine harvesters;
  • You will start with smaller pieces and gradually grow into working on larger components;
  • To work efficiently, you can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You manufacture unique parts based on technical drawings, with little repetitive series work;
  • You accurately measure and check finished products.
As a CNC TURNER in the BREDENE region, you can identify with the following:

  • You have experience as a conventional turner, milling machine operator or CNC turner? Great, we are looking for you!
  • We have approximately 25 machines. You will not have a fixed workstation but will learn to operate almost all of them. You will start on a standard lathe and gradually develop your skills;
  • You can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

• You work under the supervision of the kitchen responsible 

• You carry out preparations according to instructions from the person in charge 

• You help with the mise-en-place of the dishes: clean, wash, peel, cut and cook food 

• You help the responsible person prepare the orders during the shift 

• You operate fryer and BBQ during service 

• You provide a smooth and efficient briefing to colleagues for the next shift 

• You label and store all foodstuffs according to HACCP standards 

• You clean up after the shift and you clean working tools 

• You help with dishes during and after service 

• You respect safety standards during the work  

--> We need help daily from 3pm/5.30pm to 10pm

 

• !Minimum 1y experience in kitchens! 

• Experience with fryer and/or BBQ are a plus 

• Hard working 

• Clean and organized 

• Team player 

• Willing to work evenings & weekends 

• English is the main used language 

• AVAILABLE minimum 2 days/week from 4pm to 11pm

For a transport company in Rekkem, we are looking for several CE drivers. Profiles wanted:
 
 
 
• CE drivers 
 
• Mooffett (truck-mounted forklift) drivers 
 

 Possibility of 2 to 3 overnight stays per week (UK). Also opportunities for drivers who prefer to be home more frequently or daily.

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• Living within approximately 20 minutes of our site at LAR in Rekkem

This Receptionist role is a front-of-house position focused on delivering a professional experience to visitors while ensuring the smooth day-to-day coordination of office operations, meeting facilities and administrative support. The successful candidate will manage reception activities, room bookings, travel arrangements, courier services and general office support within an international business environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is a prestigious international law firm based in Brussels. To support its operations during a temporary period, they are currently looking for a Receptionist to join their team until the end of December.

 

Description

As a Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for visitors and play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing the switchboard, forwarding calls, screening incoming calls and taking messages.
• Welcoming visitors and ensuring a professional reception experience.
• Supporting visitors with administrative requests such as printing, copying and other practical needs.
• Managing visitor badges and access procedures.
• Coordinating meeting room bookings and updating reservations as required.
• Ordering catering services and assisting with meeting room set-up when needed.
• Monitoring conference rooms and liaising with internal teams to ensure facilities are maintained.
• Arranging travel, hotel, restaurant and transportation bookings.
• Organising courier services and outgoing mail.
• Coordinating flower orders and other office-related requests.
• Acting as a point of contact with IT and other support functions when required.

 

• Previous experience in a Receptionist, Front Office or Administrative Support role.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Professional, positive and service-oriented attitude.
• Fluent English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
• Good command of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to remain calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
• Proactive, flexible and reliable approach to work.
• Team player with excellent relationship-building skills.

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, the organisation is seeking an Administration Officer to support its administrative, financial and office management activities and help ensure the efficient running of its operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage shared mailboxes and handle day-to-day business correspondence.
• Process invoices and maintain accurate supplier and financial records.
• Support payment processing, budget tracking and expense administration.
• Coordinate with external finance partners and maintain relevant documentation.
• Oversee recurring fees, contributions and other incoming payments.
• Track contracts, renewals, deadlines and purchasing activities.
• Prepare administrative and financial reports, dashboards and internal tracking files.
• Ensure project documentation, agreements and supporting records are complete and up to date.
• Assist with the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate office facilities, suppliers, equipment and service providers.
• Support employee onboarding and offboarding administration.
• Maintain efficient filing systems and contribute to process improvements.
• Provide broader administrative and operational support as needed.

A successful Project Officer should have:

• Previous experience in administration, operations support, office coordination or a similar role.
• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of internal and external stakeholders.

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work in the weekend. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

Our client is an international organisation operating within the consumer goods and retail sector.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Participate in purchasing and commercial projects with a focus on value creation and business performance.
• Coordinate and facilitate discussions between various stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
• Support negotiations, prepare relevant documentation and follow up on agreed actions.
• Analyse data and market insights to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
• Prepare presentations, reports and recommendations for management and project teams.
• Contribute to innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement initiatives.

Successful Candidate Profile

CONCRETE WORKER – BORNEM – FULLTIME DAILY HOURS
At Manpower, we are looking for a Concrete Worker for a hands-on production environment where you see real results every day. As a Concrete Worker, you work in a fixed team where colleagues know each other and help out. The workplace is a concrete workshop with clear workstations and practical equipment. What makes this Concrete Worker job different? You receive on-the-job training so you can gradually take on more responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

• You help produce precast concrete elements.
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.
As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
• You can work both independently and in a team.
• You work safely and in an orderly way.
Nice-to-haves

• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.
